name: classify-size
description: Use to classify a feature into XS/S/M/L/XL and write docs/features/{slug}/.size so later skills know how much of each artifact to produce. Triggers on "classify size", "feature size", "is this XS or M for {slug}", "size {slug}", "/sdlc:classify-size {slug}", "класифікуй розмір {slug}", "який розмір фічі", "XS чи M". Asks four AskUserQuestion (PR count / time / new module-API-migration / breaking changes), maps to a size class via the shared size matrix, confirms with the user, and writes the one-line .size file. Syncs with PRD.md frontmatter feature_size: if present (warns on conflict). Output: docs/features/{slug}/.size + (opt.) PRD frontmatter update.
